name: marriageable men
evidence: causal, largest (Autor China-shock; Kearney-Wilson fracking) - but raises BIRTHS not MARRIAGE (partly non-marital), so it partly routes around coupling into direct fertility

name: young-adult cost compression
evidence: causal but NET-SMALL - house prices help owners (+5%) and hurt renters (-2.4%), net +0.8% (Dettling-Kearney); mostly a timing shift via liquidity

name: the time lever
evidence: plausible, UNPROVEN - Korea's 35-45hr sweet spot for pregnancy intention (Kim 2023) is cross-sectional; no 4-day-week -> births trial has reported

name: anti-atomisation (kin proximity)
evidence: causal but conditional+modest - grandmother >=200km ~1 fewer child (Engelhardt 2019); modern effect fires only where public childcare is absent (retirement-IV); co-housing untested; CHEAP -> harbinger candidate

name: positional arms-control
evidence: mechanism strong (Doepke inequality->intensive parenting; Korea $19.7B tutoring race) but INTERVENTION unproven - no jurisdiction dampened positional competition and measured more births; the blunt version (tutoring ban) backfired in E16

name: income not degrees (the education paradox)
evidence: raising male INCOME (vocational) bends Korea +0.51; male DEGREES only +0.20 because the arms-race + postponement eat ~+0.18; both super-additive +0.98, but the efficient move is income, not the credential war

name: the contrarian optimal bundle
evidence: male income + kin-proximity + equity-at-home bends Korea +1.08, beating naive degrees+cash +0.25; ablates to a lean core: male income+kin proximity+equity-at-home
